nodes.text: Protect your Command Centre; losing it ends the battle. You have 4 minutes to prepare before Wave 1 starts automatically. Survive 15 rounds and clear the final enemies to win.
Waves follow their own timer, even while enemies remain. During a countdown, SKIP WAVE calls the next wave early; it does not clear enemies. Destroying enemies earns power.

REWARDS on Home shows your saved phone wallet and portable inventory. A new wallet starts with 350 crystals. Each actually completed wave earns 5 crystals, saved once even if you later lose. Waves can overlap; starting or skipping a wave earns nothing. A win also pays 60 / 80 / 100 on Easy / Medium / Hard, plus 50 for that map's first completion. The final receipt includes crystals already earned during play.

On Home choose an item and quantity, then BUY to add stock and select an amount to take, within the match limits. The Use owned row's + and − controls adjust that selection; set it to 0 to leave the item in storage. The selection is applied when the game starts. In-game REWARDS buys boosts for the current match immediately. Purchases work on any map. Bulk quantities include 5, 10, 15, 20 and +5. You can take up to three fortresses combined. Every purchased structure still uses its normal in-game power cost.

SAVE keeps the current native game on your phone. Open Saved Games on Home to load or delete it. Saved matches retain their wave credits, purchases and used allowances; reloading pays no crystals twice. Unused stock in a saved match stays reserved until its last save is deleted.

A building purchase is used when its foundation appears, including if it is later destroyed. Unused building stock returns after the match or a confirmed return Home. Research accelerator adds 25% speed while you choose topics; Supply reserve adds 1,000 starting power. These two boosts are used when the match starts.

The Laser Satellite Command Post is a weapon, separate from your Satellite Uplink. Build and complete the post, tap it on the battlefield to select it, then press FIRE SAT and tap a visible enemy unit or building. Its native recharge time is shown in the header. Press CANCEL SAT or Back to cancel targeting.

BUILD selects construction trucks visible in your view. Choose a structure, then tap valid locations to queue sites. For walls, gates, towers and hardpoints, drag a straight line and release to queue the clear sites shown in the preview. Factories, labs, power generators and modules stay single placements. Green blueprints mark accepted orders. Your manually selected truck group is kept when choosing structures.

For another area, move the view and use TRUCKS to select its visible trucks. EXIT · KEEP ORDERS or SELECT / MOVE leaves placement while trucks continue. STOP cancels selected trucks’ work and remaining sites.
In BUILD → MODULES, choose an upgrade and tap a highlighted, completed matching building: Research Module → research lab; Power Module → power generator; Factory Module → vehicle or VTOL factory.

Labs and power generators each take one module; vehicle and VTOL factories take two. Highlights show ready, upgrading or full buildings. Finish the matching structure or research the module first if none is ready.

Top RESEARCH opens the full page. Choose a lab and tap one or more available topics. Numbers show your selection order; tap a selected topic again to deselect it. ADD TO LAB … QUEUE adds the selection in that order. Each lab follows its own queue. Use × to remove a waiting topic.
Tap one of your completed labs on the battlefield to open that lab’s full research page.

Bottom-left RESEARCH and PRODUCTION open narrow status panels while you watch the battlefield. Research shows each lab’s current topic and estimated progress; Production shows current units, with vehicle and cyborg tabs.
These panels show current work only. Use top RESEARCH or PRODUCTION to change queues. Tap the selected footer button again or × to close the panel.

Open top PRODUCTION, or tap one of your completed factories on the battlefield. Select the intended factory, choose QUANTITY (1, 5, 10 or 20), then PRODUCE a compatible design. Orders belong to the selected factory. Use UNITS, DESIGN and BLUEPRINTS inside Production to switch tasks.
Production uses normal power and build time. Research, factory type, modules and unit limits still apply. The full page shows current work and waiting units; QUEUE shows wider activity.
In PRODUCTION → DESIGN, choose a researched body, propulsion and weapon or system; name it and SAVE BLUEPRINT. Edit with SAVE CHANGES, or keep another version with SAVE AS NEW.

In Production’s ••• menu, SAVE DESIGN TO PHONE keeps the selected factory design. BLUEPRINTS stores blueprints on this phone between games and app restarts. Saving a blueprint does not unlock its parts: research them again in the current battle before production.
Tap to select or give an order; swipe to pan; pinch to zoom. Move two fingers together up/down to tilt. Tap the minimap to move the view; BASE returns to your Command Centre.

The bottom-left units icon opens SELECT / MOVE, ALL UNITS, DESELECT, STOP and TRUCKS. ALL UNITS selects combat units. DESELECT clears selection while units continue their existing orders. Android Back closes the current panel first; from the battlefield it asks Return to Main Menu.

Tap a top menu button again to close its menu. Set control size above. Music is included in the app and available offline. Each map has an assigned soundtrack; top MUSIC shows its title and lets you turn music ON or OFF. Your choice stays saved on this phone and does not change sound effects.
The battle continues while this guide is open.
